entities.name: Wren Halloway
entities.notes: Protagonist. Referred to by pronoun across whole paragraphs in Day 1 EV and The weir.

entities.name: Tamsin Reeve
entities.notes: Nickname/alias pair: Old Tam is Tamsin Reeve. Misspelled Tamsin Reave once (defect d-typo).

entities.name: Brother Ilex
entities.notes: Indirect mention only in Day 1 EV (the chapel keeper, the bell-ringer); named from The chapel path on.

entities.name: Maud Pellow
entities.notes: Only ever appears as a possessive: Maud Pellow's stew, Maud's stew.

entities.name: Corvin Ashby
entities.notes: Mentioned once, inside Captain Marsh's dialogue; never on stage.

entities.name: Oriel Marsh
entities.notes: Titled name. Drowns in The weir and reappears in The toll (defect d-marsh-alive).

entities.name: Pip Halloway
entities.notes: Wren's brother. Twelve on one branch, eleven on the other (contradiction c-pip-age).

entities.name: Widow Kestle
entities.notes: Titled name. Says she was never anyone's wife: the intentional mystery c-widow-never-wife.

entities.name: Weir House
entities.notes: Referred to two ways: the wardens call it the Weir House; the town calls it the old mill.

quotes: every working day of those forty years

quotes: Eleven years old and out after the bell

quotes: The Widow Kestle lived in the last house
